name: Nehushtan
brief: The bronze serpent made by Moses in the wilderness
short: Nehushtan, mentioned in <ref="2Ki.18.4">2Ki.18.4</ref>, was the name given to the bronze serpent that Moses made in the wilderness (<ref="Numbers 21:8-9">Numbers 21:8-9</ref>), which had become an object of idolatrous worship by the time of King Hezekiah.
